recipe.visualDefinition: A muscular, bull-headed humanoid figure kneels on a dark rock amidst rippling water, holding a glowing white lightning bolt horizontally across its chest and a golden sun-faced shield. The background features a dramatic radial burst of dark purple and black rays emanating from behind the figure's head.
coreVisualRelationships: The lightning bolt acts as a horizontal counterpoint to the verticality of the kneeling figure.
The golden shield provides a warm focal point against the cool purple and blue environment.
Radial background lines converge at the figure's head, emphasizing the mythological power.
coreInvariants: Glowing white lightning bolt with jagged edges
Golden shield featuring a relief of a human face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, full-body kneeling figure occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The golden sun shield positioned at the figure's groin/midsection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the glowing lightning bolt, move down to the golden shield, then follow the radial rays back up to the bull's head.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep purple atmospheric space in the upper corners and lower water foreground.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple and deep violet (background and water shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (lightning bolt) and deep black (radial rays).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold and ochre (shield and skin highlights).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing bolt and the dark background; low saturation in the purple tones creates a hazy, dreamlike quality.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon greens or bright reds
Limit to purples, golds, and whites

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extreme letter spacing (tracking) across the top margin
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a frame-like effect.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and geometric structure.
Provides the classic mid-century slab serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed fantasy illustration of a muscular minotaur kneeling on a rock in purple water, holding a glowing white lightning bolt and a golden sun-faced shield, with a dark purple radial burst background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase slab-serif text across the top edge with very wide tracking in a muted gold color.

verificationChecks: Text is placed at the very top edge
Lightning bolt has a distinct glow effect
Background rays are centered behind the head

adjustableVariables: Sharpness of the lightning bolt edges
Detail level of the shield face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the shield to avoid direct copying
Exact silhouette of the bull horns
postGenerationChecks: Does the text span the full width of the image?
Is the lightning bolt the brightest element?
Is the purple palette consistent across water and sky?
Does the figure feel grounded on the rock?
recipe.reuseFormula: Airbrush fantasy style + mythological hybrid subject + radial burst background + wide-tracked slab serif header.
